Rules.InvariantScript: If(SortDescending1, "Sort list in reverse alphabetical order", "Sort list in alphabetical order")

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        VIR_RealTime_FeedBack,
        CurrentUser = Attending,
        StartsWith(ResidentName, TextSearchBox1.Text)
    ),
    "ID",
    If(SortDescending1, SortOrder.Descending, SortOrder.Descending)
)
